maria (AE): Aurora Systems wants a 3-week POC. They asked: what we need, what security artifacts we can share, and a pilot cost. Can we sketch a quick POC scope?
dinesh (Solutions): Sure. Ask for their labeled eval slice and a representative traffic dump (anonymized). Core use cases?
maria (AE): They listed: ticket triage/classification, 1-2 sentence ticket summaries, and semantic search using embeddings. Pilot traffic ~50k messages/day. Prefer eu-west hosting.
claire (Security): For POC we can provide: our standard DPA template, a redacted SOC2 Type II summary, network diagram showing eu-west hosting, KMS/integration notes, and pen-test guidance. Note: if PHI is included we escalate for BAA — not covered in trial flow.
tess (Legal): DPA turnaround: legal needs ~3 business days once they return edits. Please capture their legal contact. Also clarify IP: default is customer owns inputs/outputs; we'll include explicit language in the POC SOW.
dinesh (Solutions): Proposed success criteria to include in SOW:
- classification: F1 >= 0.82 on their labelled set
- summarization: ROUGE-L >= baseline +10%
- embeddings: recall@10 >= 0.75
- latency: p95 < 250ms single-request path (eu-west)
- stability: 48h continuous run with <1% error rate
maria (AE): They want pilot cost and data residency confirmation. Claire?
claire (Security): Hosted eu-west is fine for pilot. If they need strict residency/no-egress we need Redwood Private (VPC) — that changes price and setup time. For raw logs: we require explicit approval before sharing; otherwise provide aggregated/obfuscated samples.
dinesh (Solutions): For eval assets ask for: 500 labeled examples (for metric runs) + an unlabeled stream/sample for latency profiling. We'll run model variants and return a short eval report with recommended model/quantization.
claire (Security): Pen-test request: they want to run a light external test. Our standard process:
- customer submits scope + IPs
- agree a short testing window and allowed test types
- Redwood sec POC monitors
- we triage findings within 5 business days
We won't allow heavy load simulations that could impact other customers.
ops-bot: checklist created: [DPA, SOC2-extract, eu-west-diagram, KMS-notes, pen-test-guidelines] (owner: claire).
tess (Legal): If they confirm GDPR data subject requests in-scope, include dataflow mapping and retention terms in DPA.
maria (AE): Tentative timeline: send docs today; receive eval set by next Mon; launch pilot following week. Can we commit?
dinesh (Solutions): Yes if we get the labeled set by Mon. I'll prepare run plan and cost estimate (hosted ~ $1.2k/week estimate).
claire (Security): I'll prepare the SOC2 extract and pen-test one-pager by EOD.
tess (Legal): I'll queue the DPA. If Aurora flags HIPAA, escalate immediately.
maria (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Aurora and book kickoff. :thumbsup:
